findings.text: test_copies_every_skill_with_references contains the vacuous assertion `sorted(p.name for p in dest.iterdir()) is not None` (always true); the set of copied skill directories is never compared to the bundle there, and no test pins the count of 26 (skills come from whatever dist/skills holds). Only the default-target test compares names exactly (`== skills`), so the --target path could copy extra or too few dirs undetected beyond the SKILL.md-per-bundled-skill check.

findings.ac: AC3: Antigravity IDE discovers all copied skills
findings.text: No test, script text or doc assertion covers discovery by Antigravity; it is manual-only. The tests verify only file placement under ~/.gemini/config/skills, not that Antigravity lists the skills.
Per-skill copy completeness is asserted only for SKILL.md and references/* files; other shipped subtrees such as agents/openai.yaml sidecars (HITL) are not asserted to be copied by the bridge tests.
